page_title: EIN 1-3 MAI | Eintracht Frankfurt v Mainz 21/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Robin Zentner scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Florian Badstubner interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
89' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes it short.
88' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner kick.
86' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Stefan Bell is replaced by Moritz Jenz (Mainz).
86' A substitution has been made. Nikolas Veratschnig is replaced by Karim Onisiwo (Mainz).
85' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
82' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

82' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.
80' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
80' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anthony Caci departs the field of play to be replaced by Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
76' Substitution. Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz) on for Jae-Sung Lee.

75' 1 - 3 Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:3.
75' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
74' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt), but it's just over the bar.
74' Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.

74' Anthony Caci (Mainz) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
73' Paul Nebel (Mainz) takes the corner.
72' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.

71' Eintracht Frankfurt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a corner.
70' Eintracht Frankfurt quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
70' Eintracht Frankfurt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

69' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Robin Zentner was alert and the score remains the same.
67' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) is adjudged offside.
64' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.
63' Danny da Costa (Mainz) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
62' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Florian Badstubner blows for a foul.
60' Here is a change. Fares Chaibi is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
60' It's time for a substitution. Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Hugo Ekitike.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Hojlund trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
60' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings his opponent down. Florian Badstubner has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Zentner comes off his line to gather the ball.
58' 0 - 3 Goal! Paul Nebel (Mainz) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:3.
58' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Kaua Santos.
58' It is time for a substitution. Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) is on for Armindo Sieb.
53' Mainz are ruled offside.
52' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

52' Paul Nebel (Mainz) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Mainz force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
50' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

50' The corner is swung in but Eintracht Frankfurt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
49' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ellyes Skhiri comes off for Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Nnamdi Collins is replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' The whistle blows and Florian Badstubner starts the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.

45' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now.
44' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
42' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Robin Zentner has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
39' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared to safety by the defence.
37' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt).

37' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Zentner was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
37' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner with a short pass.
36' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
35' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
33' Looks like Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
33' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

33' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
29' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) but poses no threat.
27' 0 - 2 Paul Nebel (Mainz) has a sight of goal and unleashes a strike from the edge of the penalty area that somehow goes past the helpless goalkeeper.
26' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
24' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
24' Hugo Ekitike loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt).
21' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes out his opponent with an awful tackle and is shown a red card by the referee!
19' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
19' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt) scores into his own net!
13' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
11' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
8' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
8' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner kick.
4' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Eintracht Frankfurt, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Florian Badstubner blows the whistle, Danny da Costa (Mainz) is penalised for a foul.
1' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Mainz will have the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner will supervise the game today.
